## Bio

PhD candidate studying snow accumulation in mountain forests at the University of Saskatchewan's Centre for Hydrology in Canmore, AB. 

<p></p>

#### Websites

**[CCRN-weather-data](https://hydronet.shinyapps.io/ccrn/)** | A website to visualize hydrometeorological data for the [University of Saskatchewan - Cold Regions Hydrological Observatory](https://research-groups.usask.ca/hydrology/) network of weather stations | 2021
